payload.rationale: The obligation asks whether FY2025 enforceable effluent limitations and monitoring requirements are set forth in permit Parts, with fact sheets and statements of basis serving as supporting rationale rather than as independent operative limits. The packet partially supports an operative-Parts reading for NM0020583: the Farmington final permit cover states that effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions are set forth in Part I through Part IV. However, the packet does not establish that distinction for NM0028762 or NM0000116, which are represented only by statement-of-basis and fact-sheet cover pages with no corresponding final-permit Parts excerpts. The fact-sheet and statement-of-basis spans identify draft supporting document types but do not show that they contain only rationale and no independently enforceable numeric limits, nor do they explicitly disclaim operative authority. The FY2025 window is grounded, but no span ties the operative-source distinction to all three obligated facilities for that period. ACCEPT would require establishing the operative-Parts versus rationale-only supporting-document distinction across the obligation; REJECT would require establishing that supporting documents are independent operative limits. Neither burden is met, so UNRESOLVED is the correct disposition.
